name: vocarb
description: A vocabulary flashcard app for Arabic and Chinese vocab for my class

paragraphs: A single-page flashcard app for studying Arabic vocabulary with Chinese and English translations. Built for a small class: anyone can study and takequizzes, while the word bank is managed by the owner through a hidden admin mode. Vocabulary lives in Supabase (PostgreSQL), English meanings are fetched through a free keyless translation API via a Vercel serverless function, and new words are added inside the app.
features: Bulk import — paste a weekly word list (Chinese + Arabic per line); the parser handles numbered and bulleted WhatsApp-style lists, auto-swaps reversed sides, strips cross-script contamination (e.g. a stray Chinese…
Sets — organize words into sets (Week 12, Week 13, …) or review everything
Both directions — CN → AR or AR → CN; pinyin shown above Chinese, full harakat on the Arabic
Keyboard-first — Space to flip, arrow keys to navigate
